artifacts.summary: TM-star built and its metatheory landed: soundness at all four frame classes, the embedding of every TM-plus derivation, unconditional conservativity over TM in both directions, and a proved conditional pair over TM-plus whose unconditional contrapositive shows any separating witness is a TM-plus incompleteness witness; TM-star completeness recorded OPEN under two named obstructions.

completion_data.completion_summary: Built TM-star, the proof system for L-star (StarAxiom via one ofBase constructor plus 16 register schemata, StarDerivationTree with the star-derivability notation), and landed its metatheory: soundness at all four frame classes with temporal duality discharged semantically, the embedding of every TM-plus derivation, and the conservativity verdict at the strength the evidence supports - unconditional over TM in both directions at all four classes, and a proved conditional pair over TM-plus. TM-star completeness is recorded as OPEN under two named obstructions (the deterministic-countermodel engine obstruction, which unlike the L-plus case admits no narrow-to-deterministic escape because registers do not collapse there; and the hybrid pure-axiom route's need for nominals, which L-star has none of), never stubbed. Three machine-checked negative results now live in the tree: refute_modal_future (MF is not an L-star schema, which is why the TM block is embedded rather than re-declared), and the storeG_recall_valid / refute_erasure pair (register erasure is not a conservativity translation).

phase_exclusions.item: general stab-necessitation at an arbitrary StarFormula
phase_exclusions.reason: Not derivable from the pinned Phase 3 axiom set: MS reaches TM-star only as StarAxiom.ofBase _ (PlusAxiom.box_stab psi), whose instances are box (ofPlus psi) -> stab (ofPlus psi), so modus_ponens has no instance at a register-containing formula. Landed instead as stabNecessitationOfPlus at ofPlus instances, under a distinct name. The rule remains sound at every formula - an underivability, not an unsoundness - and is recorded in the module docstring and StarLanguage/README.md. A native box_stab schema would remove the restriction but would break the constructor list pinned in the plan's Lean Challenge Statements.
